notes: Evaluated on a stratified sample (stratified on split) of 500 of the 3,030 images in the train split (16.5%, seed=42); every model is scored on the identical subset, so results are comparable across models on this dataset but are an estimate of full-split performance. Grounding DINO detection prompt: the dataset's category names, lowercased and joined into a single caption "name1. name2. ..."; each box's score for a label is the max sigmoid score over that label's caption tokens. No score threshold is applied: every predicted box is a candidate for every label, and the top 100 boxes per label per image are kept. mAP is COCO-style mAP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.95 and mAP50 is AP at IoU 0.50 (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision, bbox).

Evaluated on a stratified sample (stratified on split) of 500 of the 3,030 images in the train split (16.5%, seed=42); every model is scored on the identical subset, so results are comparable across models on this dataset but are an estimate of full-split performance. OWLv2 detection prompt: one text query per dataset category name. Images larger than twice the model's input side are downscaled before preprocessing; boxes are rescaled to the original image size before scoring. No score threshold is applied: every predicted box is a candidate for every label, and the top 100 boxes per label per image are kept. mAP is COCO-style mAP averaged over IoU 0.50:0.95 and mAP50 is AP at IoU 0.50 (torchmetrics MeanAveragePrecision, bbox).
